text: Level two, question three: how much water must evaporate from eighty litres of a fifteen percent sugar solution to make it twenty percent? Question four: forty grams of an alloy that is sixty percent silver is melted with ten grams of pure silver; find the purity of the new alloy. Question five: a milkman adds two litres of water to ten litres of milk and sells the mixture at the cost price of milk; find his profit percent.
